decision: Defined completion as one canonical experiment path with immutable validated artifacts and no legacy callers
why: The refactor needs a falsifiable finish condition before a large change starts

decision: Kept the existing dirty worktree in place
why: The current edits belong to the user and may overlap the Qwen path

decision: Chose typed coordination over a content-addressed artifact graph
why: Histories, questions, calls, and reports have different identity and retry rules

decision: Added coherent version 2 checkpoint generations and immutable terminal runs
why: A pointer published after a commit record prevents mixed manifest and result generations

decision: Replaced the top-level benchmark module with three typed adapters and one registry
why: Each benchmark now owns its source shape and can no longer import a sibling runner

decision: Moved model and LoRA settings into typed inference modules
why: A model revision and its engine settings now have one owner

decision: Moved memory policy and durable execution files into the package
why: Top-level shared modules obscured ownership and forced source-list duplication

decision: Made response persistence an observable state before output validation
why: A received response must be durable before parsing or a crash can cause an unsafe replay

decision: Replaced model and benchmark branches with one preset-driven coordinator and CLI
why: New benchmark-model combinations should be data, not scripts
result: fixture CLI passes end to end

decision: Recovered durable response_saved and complete calls without replay
why: A crash between response persistence and derived artifact creation must not create a second billable call

decision: Kept BEAM rubric nuggets as independent calls inside the shared judge interface
why: Combining nuggets would change the benchmark score and prompt semantics

decision: Removed dead runtime wrappers and moved distinct audits under tools
why: The canonical path is clearer when retired runners cannot be invoked

decision: Split frozen experiment identity from full run identity
why: A characterization test that hashes every package file only asserts that nobody edited code, and fails on every commit
result: 96 offline tests pass; configuration hashes stable across code edits
